def ReadAtOffset(self, offset, size=None):
    """Reads a byte string from the gzip member at the specified offset.

    The function will read a byte string of the specified size or
    all of the remaining data if no size was specified.

    Args:
      offset (int): offset within the uncompressed data in this member to
        read from.
      size (Optional[int]): maximum number of bytes to read, where None
          represents all remaining data, to a maximum of the uncompressed
          cache size.

    Returns:
      bytes: data read.

    Raises:
      IOError: if the read failed.
      ValueError: if a negative read size or offset is specified.
    """
    Returns:
       bytes: byte string read from the gzip member.

     Raises:
       IOError: if the read failed.
       OSError: if the read failed.
     """
     if size is None:
       size = self.uncompressed_size - offset

     if size > self.uncompressed_size - offset:
       raise IOError('Read size is out of range.')

     if size > self.uncompressed_cache_size:
       size = self.uncompressed_cache_size

     if offset < self.uncompressed_cache_offset:
       # The offset is before the current cache, so read the data from the
       # beginning of the cache to the offset.
       read_offset = self.uncompressed_cache_offset
       read_size = offset - read_offset
       read_data = self.ReadAtOffset(read_offset, read_size)
       read_data += self._ReadUncompressedData(offset, size)
     elif offset + size > self.uncompressed_cache_offset + self.uncompressed_cache_size:
       # The offset is after the current cache, so read the data from the
       # offset to the end of the cache, then read the data from the beginning
       # of the cache to the offset.
       read_offset = self.uncompressed_cache_offset
       read_size = self.uncompressed_cache_size - read_offset
       read_data = self.ReadAtOffset(read_offset, read_size)
       read_data += self._ReadUncompressedData(offset, size)
     else:
       # The offset is within the current cache, so just read the data from
       # the offset to the offset + size.
       read_offset = offset - self.uncompressed_cache_offset
       read_size = size
       read_data = self._ReadUncompressedData(read_offset, read_size)

     return read_data
